name: Rekka Yuzu-Cardamom Gummies
manufacturer: Rekka Candy Works (Corponation: Rekka Foods, mass market)
description: Standard-format synth-gelatin gummies in yuzu-cardamom flavor, shaped like irregular geometric fragments rather than the traditional bears or worms. Rekka's mid-catalog offering — not their flagship, not their cheapest, exactly calibrated for consistent repeat purchase.
flavor_profile: Clean yuzu brightness with warm spiced cardamom undertone; synth-gelatin gives a slightly firmer chew than organic-base gummies, flavor releases slowly
cultural_context: Rekka gummies are the background noise of Meridian 88's candy market — present everywhere, eaten without ceremony, bought on reflex. The geometric fragment shape was a deliberate design choice to avoid any cultural specificity, making them universally legible. They are the candy equivalent of ambient architecture. Almost no one's favorite, almost no one's last choice.
story_hooks: A specific production run of Rekka yuzu-cardamom gummies has an anomalous compound present — not dangerous, but it shouldn't be there, and tracing the contamination source leads somewhere unexpected.
A Tier 1 kid has been collecting the geometric gummy shapes obsessively, convinced the fragments form a map — and they might not be wrong.
Rekka's mass-market ubiquity means their vending machines are everywhere, including in places that officially don't exist — a maintenance worker has started mapping the discrepancies.
